term: cause of becoming, contrasted with being
definition: An agent's causal role in the effect's coming-to-be; the q.104 builder example need not be a direct causal role on which its continued esse depends. This is not a claim that coming-to-be and being have no causal connection.
note: Lean: a primitive parameter of the sense-fork frame (its own declaration, distinct from the other senses of its disambiguation); it carries no definitional body.
